subject: Temporary handover: cross-org rapid escalation ladder & on-call swap for short-notice maintenance
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@portwave-ops.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: alex.duarte@portwave-ops.com
Date: 2028-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short-notice maintenance — request for interim P1/P2 handover and escalation ladder

Evelyn,

We're planning a short-notice re-IP and rack migration in our secondary DC (PHX) this weekend. The maintenance window is 2028-06-09 02:00–06:00 PDT. Because traffic will momentarily shift and our sidecar proxies will be cycling, we anticipate a brief spike in error rates and a potential increase in P1s during the first 30–90 minutes post-cutover.

Given the tight timeline, we need to request the following from Redwood for that 4-hour window:
- Temporary delegation of P1 initial ACK to Redwood on-call (your dedicated responders) with a 15-minute ACK target and 60-minute mitigation expectation.
- An escalations ladder that involves PortWave Ops -> Redwood on-call -> Redwood senior on-call -> vendor escalation (network partner) if not resolved in 60 minutes.
- A named point-of-contact on Redwood side who can accept rapid ownership and be reachable by phone/Slack alongside the regular on-call channel.

We've attached our migration runbook and a simple escalation chart. This is a short, one-off ask — we do not expect to modify our long-term SLA. If you can confirm the handover process and the Redwood contacts, that would help our change board sign-off tonight.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Site Reliability — PortWave Logistics

Attachments: portwave_dc_migration_runbook.pdf (runbook, 12 pages), proposed_escalation_chart.png (diagram)
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@portwave-ops.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-07T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-notice maintenance — request for interim P1/P2 handover and escalation ladder

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and for the runbook. Quick summary of next steps from Redwood's side and a proposed interim process below.

High-level acceptance: we can support a temporary handover for the specified window on 2028-06-09 02:00–06:00 PDT under the following constraints:
- Redwood will ACK P1s within 15 minutes and target mitigation within 60 minutes during that window.
- This is an exception window tied to the migration; our standard SLA remains unchanged.
- We need a single Redwood escalation POC who will be reachable by phone and Slack throughout the window.

Proposed on-call & escalation matrix (interim, for the window):
1) Redwood primary on-call — triage and ACK (regular channel): priya_natarajan@redwood.com (phone: +1-415-555-0143).
2) Redwood senior on-call — escalation if triage not progressing after 30 minutes: marcus_lin@redwood.com (phone: +1-650-555-0199).
3) Redwood director on-call — final escalation (60+ minutes or cross-org coordination): jonas_weber@redwood.com.

Operational notes / requirements from PortWave:
- Please add the Redwood on-call phone numbers to your change board contact list and have a single change manager call the primary Redwood POC when you begin cutover.
- Share any immediate failure-mode telemetry (error burst graphs, last 5 minutes of proxy logs) on the SUP-2219 ticket to accelerate diagnosis.

We will also request a short internal override so the on-call engineers accept P1 ACK responsibility for that window (I will escalate to ops leadership now). I'll reply once we have the final internal approval; Marcus and Priya are looped for awareness.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Short-notice maintenance — request for interim P1/P2 handover and escalation ladder

Thanks, Evelyn / Samira. I approved the temporary ACK/responsibility carve-in for the 4-hour window. A few operational clarifications from my side:
- If the first P1 is triaged and appears to be a PortWave config transition (proxy or routing), Redwood will provide immediate mitigation steps or a rollback recommendation and coordinate a joint bridge.
- If the root cause is on the network partner side, we will escalate to vendor on-call at the 60-minute mark and notify PortWave immediately.
- We should use the SUP-2219 Jira as our single source of truth; PortWave please post timeline entries and the first error spike screenshot there.

Marcus Lin
VP, Platform Reliability — Redwood Inference

[phone: +1-650-555-0199]

Evelyn / Marcus / Priya — confirmed.
We added the Redwood POCs to the change board and posted the pre-cutover checklist + runbook link to SUP-2219. We'll call Priya on the primary number at 01:55 PDT to hand off.

Appreciate the fast turnaround on this. We'll keep the window tight and share first-minute telemetry to the Jira ticket.

Cheers,
Samira
